newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin rises 17 cents on foreign demand, firmer LME.
newsitem.headline: KL tin rises 17 cents on foreign demand, firmer LME.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed 17 cents higher at 14.36 ringgit ($5.81) a kg, rebounding from Tuesday's fall on the back of strong foreign demand, traders said.
They said a firmer London Metal Exchange (LME) close overnight helped market sentiment.
Turnover was 147 tonnes, up from 105 on Tuesday, and were mostly taken up by European and Japanese interests.
"More foreign buying is likely as the local price is now at a discount (of $5 a tonne) to LME," said a trader. It was at a $10 premium previously. ($1=2.4710 ringgit)
